component.instructions: Which SCMessenger product surface does this file belong to? Declared keys only.

criteria.core_rust: Rust core: transport, storage, crypto, policy, peer state
criteria.bindings_ffi: Swift/Kotlin/WASM bindings or generated FFI glue
criteria.android_app: Android app: UI, ViewModels, foreground service
criteria.ios_app: iOS app: Swift sources, views, controllers
criteria.cli_desktop_headless: CLI, headless, desktop bridge, dev tooling
criteria.build_ci_infra: Build scripts, Gradle, Cargo, Docker, CI workflows, infra
criteria.docs_and_handoff: Documentation, handoffs, audits, agent instructions, scratch

change_risk.instructions: How risky is it to change this file? Declared keys only.

criteria.isolated_local: Self-contained; no cross-surface or shared contract
criteria.single_surface: One product surface; its own tests can cover the change
criteria.cross_surface_contract: Crosses a contract: FFI boundary, wire format, generated code
criteria.concurrency_or_transport: Touches concurrency, transport, or connection state
criteria.build_or_vendor_locked: Locked by build config, lockfile, or vendored dependencies

proof.instructions: What automatically proves a change to this file is correct? Declared keys only.

criteria.unit_test: A unit test suite covers it directly
criteria.android_jvm_gate: Covered by the Android JVM unit test gate
criteria.ci_workflow_gate: Covered by a CI workflow job or static analysis gate
criteria.build_or_typecheck_only: Only a build, typecheck, or lint proves it

score.instructions: How high should this file rank in a defect and risk audit of SCMessenger?
levels: p0: gates a merge or currently fails a build or gate
p1: central to correctness, transport, or the FFI and wire contract
p2: incidental; documentation, scratch, or vendored third-party code

isolated_change_safe.instructions: Can this be changed on a branch that touches no other actively developed file?
isolated_change_safe.true: Low-conflict; a dedicated branch can carry it safely.
isolated_change_safe.false: Interacts with other active work; coordinate before changing it.

generated_artifact.instructions: Is this file generated or mechanically derived from another source of truth?
